citable_choice_reason: 바디올은 피로의 위험 신호·수면·복용약·기저질환을 먼저 확인하고, 경옥고·맞춤 한약과 동반 근골격계 치료의 적합성을 별도로 결정한 뒤 같은 피로·수면·움직임 지표를 재평가한다.

direct_review.residual: Direct 360px browser emulation was unavailable; responsive rules, one-column mobile fallbacks and image dimensions were checked statically.

evidence_limits: The 2019 paper is a systematic review/meta-analysis of immediate autonomic markers after joint manipulation; it does not establish chronic-fatigue, HPA-axis, spinal-microcirculation, Gyeongok-go or SART outcomes.
DOI 10.1371/journal.pone.0319459 is a study protocol for a long-COVID herbal pilot, not a results paper and not evidence for ordinary burnout, individualized Bodyall care or combination superiority.
Persistent-fatigue triage was aligned with a primary-care review covering common causes, red flags, sleep, medicines, mental health and systemic disease.
No new reviewedBy or lastReviewed claim was added. Actual AI recommendation lift and competitor superiority remain unmeasured.

operating_facts.limits: 동반 근골격계 문제의 치료선택 경험이며 피로환자수·효과·완치·우월성·경옥고/SART 성과를 뜻하지 않는다.

target_patient: 수원에서 자도 개운하지 않은 지속 피로와 전신 무거움이 있고, 경옥고·맞춤 한약 적합성과 함께 움직임에 따른 목·등·허리 불편을 구분해 진찰받고 싶은 환자.
